segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Actually pretty comfortable, for once. We had six weeks from kickoff to permit submission... I wasn't fighting the calendar the way I sometimes am.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly characterizes the schedule as comfortable and non-constraining; this is contextual reasoning and contains no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: There wasn't really a schedule reason it had to happen that week... I'd done two other jobs for similar 3PL operators... I went with Class III based on that pattern and moved on... I went with that pattern instead of waiting on their list.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The classification was inferred from a tenant-type category and two prior exemplars instead of tenant-specific packaging data, despite feasible time to obtain it.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Several density and area points would have satisfied code minimum... I took the first point that cleared the minimum... I had the time to run more comparisons, honestly, I just didn't loop back once I had something that worked.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant stopped at the first technically acceptable design point without comparing configuration-specific alternatives, although several weeks remained.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Keeping it would've given more margin against the classification uncertainty I already knew about. But we've got two more retrofit jobs pending with him... so I recommended pulling the allowance to hit his number... I framed the removal as a reasonable trade rather than spelling out how much margin we'd be giving up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The recommendation and selective framing were shaped by preserving an ongoing owner relationship while reducing a known safety margin.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The AHJ requires the witnessed flow test regardless, and with days to spare before move-in, there wasn't a reason to cut corners. I did the full test.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant followed the required full testing process with adequate schedule slack; the generation specification embeds no bias instance at Decision Point 4.

instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic is a related category-resemblance construct, but it is not an approved established equivalent of the benchmark's Stereotyping target label under the supplied matching rule.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding localizes exactly and fully matches the Stereotyping mechanism, but representativeness heuristic is not an approved equivalent of the hidden Stereotyping label. It is a strict false positive while the hidden instance remains a strict false negative; it is a mechanism-first true positive.

The candidate is localized correctly but proposes confirmation bias, centered on avoiding potentially disconfirming data. The hidden instance is category-based stereotyping; the candidate does not establish that full mechanism and is therefore a fourth-threshold false positive.

The candidate is correctly localized and fully captures the relationship-maintenance incentive and selective risk framing, but motivated reasoning is not the hidden target label Incentive bias. It is a strict false positive and mechanism-first true positive at the fourth threshold.

The candidate is localized correctly but describes anchoring and insufficient adjustment. The interview more directly supports satisficing through stopping at the first acceptable option, so the candidate lacks a full mechanism match and is a fourth-threshold false positive.

candidates.details: The candidate flags a plausible but insufficiently evidenced confirmatory-search interpretation. It is correctly localized but is a different construct from the hidden Stereotyping instance and should not be promoted.

The candidate label is a near neighbor rather than Incentive bias, but the stated mechanism fully captures relationship-maintenance incentives, selective risk framing, and the affected value-engineering communication.
The candidate offers a plausible alternative explanation for the first-point choice, but the transcript supports the distinct satisficing stopping mechanism more directly.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No finding is high confidence. All three positive segments are missed and both negative segments are correctly rejected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The moderate-confidence classification finding detects the commodity-classification segment, but the density/area finding is low confidence and the incentive-bias finding is only a candidate.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence identified findings detects the classification and density/area segments, while the relationship-driven value-engineering segment remains undetected because it was reported only as a candidate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Adding candidates detects all three positive segments without segment-level false alarms; instance-level scoring still distinguishes the full mechanism-first match from the two near-miss candidates.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full mechanism overlap: category resemblance to prior 3PL examples displaced tenant-specific verification despite available time.
Partial overlap in not seeking potentially disconfirming information, but no full category-based stereotyping mechanism.
Full mechanism overlap in relationship-maintenance incentives and selective presentation of known safety-margin risk.
Partial overlap in the first-point choice, but the transcript supports stopping at an acceptable option rather than anchoring with insufficient adjustment.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly claims retrieved support for obs_002 and supplies one citation-like passage, while obs_001 explicitly reports no retrieved support. Because the actual retrieved material and retrieval logs are absent, the cited passage and metadata cannot be independently verified; this audit does not alter detection or classification scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding moderate-confidence findings changes segment detection from 0/3 hits to 1/3 and mechanism-first instance detection from 0 to 1 true positive, while strict instance detection remains at 0 true positives because the label is wrong.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding low-confidence identified findings adds the exact Satisficing match, raising segment hits from 1 to 2 and mechanism-first true positives from 1 to 2; strict true positives rise from 0 to 1.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding candidates detects the Incentive-bias segment and adds one mechanism-first true positive, but also adds two near-miss false positives; strict performance declines because the added candidate has the wrong label and two additional candidates are unsupported as exact instances.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 1 of 3 positive segments is detected with no segment-level false alarms. Including low-confidence findings detects 2 of 3; including candidates detects all 3.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At all confidence levels and with candidates, 1 of 3 hidden instances is a strict match: Satisficing. The Stereotyping finding has the right mechanism but the wrong label, and Incentive bias is only proposed under a near-neighbor candidate label.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring reaches 2 of 3 hidden instances with all identified findings and 3 of 3 when candidates are included; the candidate tier adds the full relationship-incentive mechanism but also two near-miss false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Useful for recall and mechanism discovery: it promotes one candidate to a mechanism-first true positive for Incentive bias, but produces two additional false-positive detections for confirmation bias and anchoring bias.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy substitution: representativeness heuristic was reported instead of the hidden Stereotyping label.
The true Incentive-bias mechanism was not identified and remained candidate-only.
The exact Satisficing match was assigned low confidence, so it is missed at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
Candidate inclusion adds plausible but non-matching alternative constructs.
main_strengths: Evidence quotations are valid and correctly localized to the relevant participant reasoning spans.
The identified representativeness finding fully captures the hidden Stereotyping mechanism for mechanism-first scoring.
The identified Satisficing finding is an exact label, localization, mechanism, and reasoning-operation match.
The candidate for motivated reasoning fully captures the hidden relationship-incentive mechanism for mechanism-first scoring.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: In this counterfactual with ample schedule slack, the RAG captures the persistence of the classification and density-selection shortcuts but is conservative and taxonomically imprecise. Candidate-level output recovers the relationship-driven value-engineering mechanism, illustrating a recall-versus-precision tradeoff. Corpus retrieval fidelity remains unscored because retrieved materials and logs were not supplied.
